product_one_liner.value: Forwood Safety provides critical-risk management software and safety expertise that help organisations in high-risk industries verify critical controls and prevent workplace fatalities and serious injuries.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page or pricing navigation was found; the pricing URL returned no readable page.

eng_blog.notes: The news archive is predominantly safety, product and marketing content. One implementation-focused QuickSight Q article was found, but not two engineer-authored build posts.

public_docs.notes: The public help collection lists login, password reset, mobile activation and CCV app setup articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable openings found were sales and critical-risk management roles; none had a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.value: Amazon Web Services — Amazon QuickSight Q
model_provider.notes: Forwood explicitly describes using QuickSight Q’s machine-learning-powered natural-language analytics; no underlying foundation-model name is disclosed.

compliance_certs.notes: ISO 27001 and GDPR are described as alignment frameworks in the privacy policy, not separate certifications.

last_funding.notes: The database dates the completed round to 2023-10-31. The investment amount is not publicly disclosed, so amount_usd is omitted.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round is October 2023, before the 2025-05-09–2026-11-09 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Account Executive – Enterprise SaaS Sales posting for Italy.

launched_6mo.notes: The latest explicit launch found was Safety+ 2.0 and its mobile app on 2025-01-21, before 2026-05-09. The June 2026 Forwood One item describes an early look at a future platform, not a launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small official executive team was checked in full; no in-window C-level/VP appointment or departure was announced. Available role histories place the commercial and operations appointments before 2025-11-09; the team page itself provides no start dates.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The implementation case study describes Zoho CRM connected to the WordPress website and LinkedIn lead forms through LeadsBridge, with marketing automation; the engagement began in May 2025.
